table.link.description: Great news! You don't need to link an account to use this module. Just click on "skip" to go to the next page.
table.trigger.entry.insert.name: Database entry insertion
table.trigger.entry.insert.input.table.d: The database in which the insertions are to be observed
table.trigger.entry.remove.name: Database entry removal
table.trigger.entry.remove.input.table.d: The database in which the removals are to be observed
table.action.entry.insert.name: Insert database entry
table.action.entry.insert.input.table.de: The database in which you want to store the entry
The content of the entry. The content has the following format: Column1=Value1, Column2=Value2, ...
An error occurred while inserting an entry into a database. The error occurred because the selected database could not be found.
An error occurred while inserting an entry into a database. The error occurred because the entered schema does not correspond to the correct one. The content must be in the following format: Column1=Value1, Column2=Value2, ...
table.action.entry.insert.failure.column: An error occurred while inserting an entry into a database. The error has occurred because a specified column does not exist.
An error occurred while inserting an entry into a database. The error has occurred because a column was specified twice.
table.action.entry.remove.name: Remove database entry
table.action.entry.remove.input.table.de: The database from which you want to remove the entry
table.action.entry.remove.input.entry.de: The id of the entry / row you want to remove
An error occurred while removing an entry from a database. The error occurred because the selected database could not be found.
An error occurred while removing an entry from a database. The error occurred because the id of the entry has the wrong format.
An error occurred while removing an entry from a database. The error occurred because the selected entry / row could not be found.
